note: Should-trigger phrasings for a company's legal and compliance work, the standards gate its Compliance Officer now keeps for every department (libel, privacy, IP and licensing, regulated claims, disclosure), and the user's own legal life (leases, contracts, disputes, wills, privacy); near misses are a neighbouring department's requests phrased close to these. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: review this vendor contract before we sign it
redline the NDA a prospect sent our company
draft terms of service and a privacy policy for our app
do we need a DPA with our analytics provider
should my startup be an LLC or a Delaware C-corp
a competitor sent us a cease and desist letter, what do we do
make sure our cofounders and contractors assign their IP to the company
set up a compliance calendar for our company's filings
check this blog post for libel or copyright problems before we publish it
can our ad say the supplement is clinically proven
do we have to disclose that this influencer post is sponsored
can I use a photo I found online in our newsletter
review my apartment lease before I sign it
my landlord won't return my security deposit, what are my rights
help me draft a simple will now that we have a baby
is the non-compete in my job offer enforceable
send a request to make this data broker delete my information
a contractor took my deposit and never finished the job, can I take him to small claims

model our cap table after the seed round
how much life insurance should I buy now that we have a baby
draft an offer letter for the engineer we want to hire
write the public statement about our data breach
make our blog post about the new pricing read better
fact-check the statistics in this article before we publish it
set up encryption and access controls for our customer database
someone got into my email account, help me lock everything down
build a cookie consent banner for our website
my new laptop arrived broken, help me get a refund from the store
find and hire a contractor to redo our kitchen
